name: Aegis (Rogue Genius Games)
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

EFFECT

Effect magic sigil on one shield touched.

DESCRIPTION

As sepia snake sigil, except it is cast on a shield and targets a creature that knocks-out or kills the shield-bearer with a sepia snake sigil.
